Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
Application stands disposed of.

An application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been preferred on behalf of the petitioner for grant of anticipatory bail in FIR No. 301/2023 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S.: Kashmere Gate, Delhi.
Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State and learned counsel for complainant along with complainant-in-person also appear on advance notice and accept notice.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is open to explore the possibility of settlement and matter be referred to mediation as also agreed by complainant.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 25/01/2024 at 10:10:11
In the facts and circumstances, the matter is referred to Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre for 18.01.2024 for mediation to be conducted preferably by a Senior Mediator.
